# Forgehand 0.2.1

Forgehand 0.2.1 makes the repository-owned automation packet safer to activate. Its Automaton installation token now requests only Issue and pull-request writes, with Checks write added only when a policy check needs it. Trusted policy reads continue through the workflow's read token. App installations without Contents access can therefore supply the writer token.

The supplied DiffDevil policy now compares the review metric with the XL threshold of 1,000 changed lines. An unknown metric still holds the XL reply instead of guessing. This corrects the policy included in the installation example and Forgehand's own disabled self-adoption source.

Existing adopters who copied the earlier DiffDevil policy should review their repository-owned `.diffdevil.yml` against the corrected example before enabling its managed check or XL reply. This release does not change an existing repository's policy, App installation, credentials, or caller pin. Forgehand's own caller remains disabled; this release does not activate its lifecycle automation or publish the self-adoption Issue.
